calls.title: Sync with Kelli
calls.summary: Khan Academy has rebuilt its experimentation platform by adopting Growth Book to address scale, cost, and integration challenges, following the deprecation of its legacy AB testing platform in 2019. The choice of Growth Book was influenced by its open-source nature, cost efficiency, and compatibility with existing data pipelines, supported by funding from the Gates Foundation. The platform allows simultaneous experiments and supports feature flags, enhancing engineering flexibility. Additionally, Khan Academy leverages AI-driven evaluation for its generative AI tutor, Khanmigo, focusing on metrics like cognitive engagement and response latency while ensuring ethical governance in AB testing. The organization aims to prioritize learning outcomes and maintain a culture of data-driven decision-making, balancing innovation with ethical considerations in education.
calls.keywords: Khan Academy, Growth Book, AB Testing, Generative AI, Khanmigo, Experimentation Culture
